idea-plugin.name: FlowTags
idea-plugin.description:
FlowTags - GitFlow & Semantic Version Manager

Seamlessly manage GitFlow branching lifecycles and automatically track Semantic Versioning (SemVer) directly inside IntelliJ IDEA.

  • Status Bar Widget: Quick access to active branches, latest merged versions, version history, and one-click copy.
  • Next Version Suggestion: Automatically calculates and suggests next Hotfix (+patch) and Release (+minor) versions by analyzing both commit history and active branches.
  • Full GitFlow Support: Built-in Init, Start (Hotfix/Release/Feature), and Finish with automatic branch merging and cleanup.
  • Conflict & Safety Checks: Prevents actions when uncommitted changes exist, alerts on merge conflicts.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.8

  • Fixed EDT assertion error 'Do not call synchronous repository update in EDT': eliminated synchronous repository queries on the UI dispatch thread when discovering multi-root repositories and initializing the status bar widget.
  • Removed redundant left/bottom ToolWindow panel to keep the IDE layout clean and lightweight, consolidating all features into the bottom-right Status Bar widget popup.

1.0.7

  • Fixed multi-project and multi-window support: reliably discover repositories across multiple concurrently opened IntelliJ project windows, including multi-module and nested subdirectories (e.g. msp-*/.git).
  • Added DumbAware background task execution: ensure version querying and Git operations run immediately without being suspended or blocked during IDE indexing.
  • Enabled status bar widget by default with instant .git/HEAD branch resolution and status bar repaint upon completion.

1.0.6

  • Fixed popup stuck on 'Calculating...': eliminated infinite re-query loop when no active branches exist, ensuring instant and clickable next version recommendations.
  • Added Git tag detection: automatically discover releases and tags (e.g. 1.0.64_20260411clip) even in repositories without traditional merge commits.
  • Added PR/MR merge commit support: recognize GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket pull request merges.

1.0.5

  • Enhanced startup reliability: reliably auto-load versions on project open with 5-stage VCS discovery, repo.update synchronization, and fallback direct branch queries without requiring manual 'git pull'.
  • Automatic date attachment: unconditionally append today's date with hyphen delimiter across Hotfix, Release, and Feature branches (e.g. 1.0.65-YYYYMMDD, feature/name-YYYYMMDD), while stripping legacy custom tags.

1.0.4

  • Enhanced version recommendation: support underscore delimiter in previous versions (e.g. 1.0.64_20260411clip) and unconditionally append today's date with hyphen across Hotfix, Release, and Feature branches (e.g. 1.0.65-YYYYMMDD, 1.1.0-YYYYMMDD, feature/name-YYYYMMDD), cleanly stripping custom tags.
  • Auto-load versions immediately upon opening project and repository discovery without requiring manual 'git pull'.

1.0.3

  • Improved branch safety checks: ignore untracked files when starting GitFlow branches so newly created or unstaged files do not block branch creation.

1.0.2

  • Added option to automatically delete remote branch (e.g. origin/feature, origin/hotfix) upon finishing GitFlow branches.
  • Smart remote detection: auto-selects remote deletion if branch is already tracked on remote.

1.0.1

  • Fixed EDT assertion error when opening status bar popup by reading Git configs directly from repository files.
  • Eliminated synchronous Git CLI process spawning on the UI thread for instant popup rendering.
  • Added custom-designed SVG icons for FlowTags, Hotfix, Release, and Feature branch types.
  • Restructured version history into a clean 1-depth submenu.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of FlowTags.
  • GitFlow Init, Start, and Finish operations with automated branch lifecycle management.
  • Dual-source Semantic Version calculator across commit history and in-progress branches.
  • Status bar widget and dedicated bottom ToolWindow with one-click version copying.
